note: Officeholders and districts as listed by Citizens Count, the NH General Court (RSA 662:5), the NH Secretary of State, the NH Executive Council, Ballotpedia, BallotReady and news coverage, checked Oct 28, 2026. Positions are the officials' own survey answers or quoted statements, with the year. Nothing here is characterized or scored.
ballot_note: All Hillsborough County offices, the Executive Council, the State Senate and every State House seat are on the Tuesday, Nov 3, 2026 ballot, along with Governor, US Senate and US House. Results will replace the names below.

levels.title: Federal
levels.blurb: Two senators and one representative. Nashua is in New Hampshire's 2nd Congressional District.

levels.title: State
levels.blurb: The Governor, your Executive Councilor (all of Nashua is in District 5) and your State Senator: Wards 1, 2 and 5 are in Senate District 12; Wards 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are in District 13.

levels.title: State House
levels.blurb: Nashua has 27 State House seats: each of its nine wards is its own three-seat district (Hillsborough 3 to 11), and no floterial district includes a Nashua ward. One Ward 3 seat has been vacant since Suzanne Vail resigned on June 15, 2026, so 26 members are listed.

levels.title: Hillsborough County
levels.blurb: The three county commissioners are the county's executive board, in charge of county finances, buildings and staff; the sheriff, registry of deeds and county attorney's office also sit under the county. Nashua is in Commissioner District 2 with Hudson, Litchfield and Pelham. Every county office is on the Nov 3 ballot.
